name: smwgraphics-creepy-hydrocity-zone
title: Creepy Hydrocity Zone
description:
This tileset was released at Winter C3 2024. I am finally uploading it. Took most of my time to draw by usinga reference from Sonic Mania. Both BGs are original and even the tileset is original. Palette is easy to edit. Play with it. Use the sample level as reference. Both BGs and tileset are animated.

For layer 3, it's wise to use either a sprite status bar, custom status bar or the Remove Status Bar patch.

Have fun!
